runs.command_script:
#!/bin/bash -euo pipefail
set -euo pipefail
# Download BLAST database if not already present
db_local_path=$(download_db.py "/home/ec2-user/experiment/reference/results/blast_db" "1200")
# Set up command
io="-db ${db_local_path}/blast_db"
par="-perc_identity 60 -max_hsps 5 -num_alignments 250 -qcov_hsp_perc 30 -num_threads 16"
fmt="6 qseqid sseqid sgi staxid qlen evalue bitscore qcovs length pident mismatch gapopen sstrand qstart qend sstart send"
# Run BLAST
zcat nt_sampled_reads.fasta.gz | blastn ${io} ${par} -outfmt "${fmt}" \
    | gzip > nt_hits.blast.gz
# Link input to output for testing
ln -s nt_sampled_reads.fasta.gz nt_in.fasta.gz

interpretation: Original joined/merged-mate production validation with20selectedexemplars per species per pooled arm.
Realtimes and CPU estimates come from completed Nextflow search tasks; they include task startup and the cached database availability check.
The default blastn task is megablast. Allfivearms use16threads and the same comprehensive core_nt.
Whole-worker allocations include provisioned EBS but are not incremental charges and must not be summed with overlapping-job allocations.
The failed orchestration attempt is preserved separately; completed search tasks were first executed after the explicit-session resume.
